
8. Agents
An agent is a coding assistant. Only detected agents can be configured.

Agent: claude
Setup stops before writing if it finds a value Fleet did not write.
  on   Write this agent's settings from your content. (Current.)
  off  Write nothing new for it. Earlier outputs stay.
Press Enter alone to choose on.
claude [on]:

Agent: codex
Setup stops before writing if it finds a value Fleet did not write.
  on   Write this agent's settings from your content.
  off  Write nothing new for it. Earlier outputs stay. (Current.)
Press Enter alone to choose off.
codex [off]:
